items.title: [$] 添加的间接寻址支持更大的 BPF 程序
items.title_orig: [$] Added indirection allows for larger BPF programs
items.summary: 从历史上看，BPF 验证器的运作方式是跟踪程序中每条可能的执行路径，并在每条指令处检查各种安全属性是否成立。这种方法是有效的，但对于具有复杂控制流的程序，可能会导致需要检查的状态数量呈指数级增长。
items.summary_orig: The BPF verifier has historically worked by tracing every possible path of execution through a program, checking, at each instruction, that various safety properties hold. This works, but it can result in an exponential increase in the number of states that need checking in programs with complicated control-flow.

items.summary: 若视频已是 H.264、音频为 AAC，用 -c copy 重封装即可；ProRes、DNxHR 等需重新编码。
items.summary_orig: Short answer: to turn a QuickTime .mov into an .mp4 , start with -c copy . If the file is already H.264 video plus AAC audio, stream copy remuxes the packets, the first-frame RGB24 md5 stays the same, and the duration does not change. If the video is ProRes, DNxHR, or another codec that MP4 players will not handle, you have to re-encode.

items.title_orig: Photon fluctuations offer new way to probe electron dynamics in crystals
items.summary: 高强度激光可让晶体产生高次谐波，研究人员借此研究固体中电子的快速运动。
items.summary_orig: Intense laser light can make a crystal emit new colors at frequencies many times higher than that of the original beam. items.title: 如何证明 AI 转换的 COBOL 程序的行为仍然相同
items.title_orig: How to prove an AI-converted COBOL program still behaves the same

items.title: 火星的熔火之心早已不复存在，但一些岩浆室可能仍然存在
items.title_orig: Mars' Molten Heart is Long Gone, but Some Magma Chambers May Persist
items.summary: 根据新的研究，火星的火山活动可能比我们想象的更加活跃。微量气体轨道飞行器在一年中的某个时候检测到了 HCl（一种与岩浆有关的化学物质），除了火山喷发之外，这种情况很难进行。这项新研究还发现了火星上新的表面裂缝，这可能是其来源
items.summary_orig: Mars may be more volcanically active than we thought, according to new research. The Trace Gas Orbiter detected HCl, a chemical associated with magma, at a time of year that's difficult except by volcanic origins. The new research also identified new surface fissures on Mars that could be the source of the chemical.
